integrity: Finite witnesses independently checked by stable permutation/Hamming calculations and explicit sorted-rotation BWT reconstruction; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The certificate covers the finite interval of lengths 31 through 64 only.
Existence and at-most-six sparse perturbation are proved; counts of all minimizers, optimality of the six-replacement threshold, and general-length sharpness are not established.
The unconditional lower bound and the BWT inverse-cycle criterion are used from cited literature.
title: A 64-length sharpness interval for completely unclustered Burrows–Wheeler images
